description: Bun test suite covering exported utility functions: parseArgs (happy path, unknown flags, repeated positionals), resolveTargetPath (positional override, env var with quotes, default fallback), stripQuotes (quote and whitespace stripping), and listFolders (directory filtering, missing path). Uses temporary directories with mkdtempSync for filesystem isolation with proper cleanup in finally blocks.
notes: Backfilled by feature-coverage-audit from current implementation evidence on 2026-06-10.
cloneOrPull and runStarsync coverage added via folded audit findings (architecture + testing audits, consolidated 2026-06-11).

Revision 1.1.0 (2026-06-11): suite grown to 19 tests - added cloneOrPull coverage (clone, pull, failures, remote URL mismatch) and runStarsync orchestration coverage with mocked Octokit and execFileSync.
spec:
1. Verify `bun test` passes all tests in test/index.test.ts.
2. Verify parseArgs tests cover --help, -h, positional target, unknown flags, and repeated positionals.
3. Verify resolveTargetPath tests cover positional override, env var with quotes, and default fallback.
4. Verify listFolders tests cover directory filtering and missing-path handling.
5. Verify stripQuotes tests cover double quotes, single quotes, and leading/trailing whitespace.
6. Verify cloneOrPull tests cover: successful clone, clone when folder exists without .git, successful pull (with mocked remote URL check), clone failure, pull failure, and remote URL mismatch — mock node:child_process execFileSync via bun:test mock (typed as returning string | undefined, not void).
7. Verify runStarsync tests cover: missing GITHUB_TOKEN → exit 1 with 'GITHUB_TOKEN is not set'; --help → exit 0 with HELP_TEXT; unknown argument → exit 2; successful sync with mocked Octokit (mock.module('@octokit/rest') with controlled paginate response) → exit 0 with success summary; partial failure (one clone throws) → exit 1 with failure summary listing the failed repo.
title: Unit Test Suite
